preflight.alpha_hypothesis: Accepted independent-source free-data consensus candidates confirmed by same-day selected core A/B entry context may deserve modest default-off paper-notional support without expanding noisy tickers.
preflight.playbook_alignment: Matches meta research priority for default-off paper adapters and the playbook's request for replacement-value context before activation. It does not retune source count, source set, FINRA thresholds, hold, or cooldown.
nearby_prior_experiments: exp-20260603-026 no-core-overlap filter rejected versus accepted comparator
preflight.prior_difference: exp-20260603-026 removed same-day core-overlap rows and underperformed the accepted comparator. This run keeps all accepted rows fixed and only scales the overlap rows by 1.10x in paper.
preflight.reproducibility: All source artifacts, canonical window metrics, accepted comparator metrics, target trades, support diagnostics, and core-overlap diagnostics are persisted under this experiment ID.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool / default_off_paper_allocation: same-day core A/B context may confirm accepted independent-source consensus rows enough to support modest paper notional.

2_history_check.exp-20260603-014: Accepted source-family consensus improved all three windows versus core.
2_history_check.exp-20260603-015: Promoted the consensus route into the shared default-off paper adapter.
2_history_check.exp-20260603-026: Filtering out core-overlap rows was positive vs core but worse than accepted comparator.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Same docs/backtesting.md three windows. Accept only if 1.10x core-overlap support beats core and the current accepted consensus comparator in aggregate and all windows.

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A retained core-overlap support field would need the shared free-data consensus paper adapter to build the same date-keyed selected-core ticker context in daily production reports and historical replay before any queue, notional, candidate priority, or order surface could change.

prediction.confidence_reason: exp-20260603-026 showed removing same-day core-overlap rows made the accepted consensus worse, so the inverse support field is plausible; the overlap sample is small and mid_weak overlap PnL is a known risk.

additional_field_check.source: same standard core baseline result used for each window

gate4.rationale: The support field was positive in aggregate, but failed the stricter accepted-comparator window, support-sample, or incremental concentration guards.

base_gate.rationale: Canonical three-window replay improved aggregate EV and PnL across all windows. No production behavior changes were made; promotion is blocked until the cross-source consensus signal is rebuilt as a shared live/backtest adapter.
